definitions: The area of a country or continent in which a particular animal or plant is found.
A set of different things of the same general type.
A large area of open land for grazing or hunting.
A line or series of mountains or hills.
The scope of a person's knowledge or abilities.
The maximum distance over which a weapon can be fired or a vehicle can travel without refuelling.
A large cooking stove with multiple burners and ovens.
examples: The range of the tiger has shrunk considerably.
The shop offers a wide range of products.
The Himalayas are a vast mountain range.
His range of interests is impressive.
The car has a range of 500 miles.
She cooked dinner on the old iron range.
